description: This file defines the 'CustomersController' class, which exposes REST API endpoints for customer management, including listing all customers, creating a new customer, and deleting a customer by ID.

classes.name: CustomersController
classes.description: REST controller managing customer-related endpoints such as listing, creation, and deletion of customers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customers using CustomersService.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer based on the provided request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by ID.
